info.title: Luna Loop Assist API
info.description: Production API for Luna Loops: Continuous Reflection, Lunar Grounding, Loops, Echoes, Threads, Co-Created Reflections, and Developer Chat Observability.

get.description: Returns the current live lunar phase, illumination percentage, cycle day (1-29), zodiac sign, and threshold/flow state.

200.description: Current lunar telemetry and phase data

get.description: Search across all user records (echoes, loops, rhythms, reflections) using text or keyword matching.

200.description: List of matching echoes, loops, and reflections

get.description: Search and filter personal Echoes by lunar phase, tags, date range, or text.

parameters.name: phase
parameters.description: Lunar phase filter (e.g. new, full, waxing-crescent)

post.description: Create a direct personal user observation. Server enforces provenance: author=user, kind=original_echo. Automatically stamps current lunar metadata.
Save an insight or reflection derived from dialogue with the user. Server enforces provenance: author=co-created, kind=conversation_reflection, source=luna_conversation.

get.description: Retrieve a specific Echo by its unique stable ID (e.g. 'e178802...').

patch.description: Update tags, loop associations, or status of an existing Echo. Text content and lunar context are strictly immutable.

get.summary: Get Reflections Attached to an Echo
get.description: List all AI reflections or conversation insights attached to a specific user Echo.

post.summary: Attach AI Reflection to an Echo
post.description: Attaches an AI reflection to an existing Echo without mutating the original Echo content.

get.description: List user loops filtered by status (active, completed, archived), lunar phase, or scope.

post.description: Create a new intention loop tied to a lunar cycle or phase with optional subtasks.

get.description: Get full details of a loop, including subtasks, connected echoes, and completion state.

patch.description: Update title, description, subtasks, or tags for an active loop.

post.description: Mark a loop as completed with an optional reflection closing note.

post.summary: Carry Loop Forward into New Cycle
post.description: Carry an active or incomplete loop into the current lunar cycle.

get.description: List longitudinal threads that weave multiple echoes and loops together.
List authenticated user's chat sessions ordered by latest activity.
Retrieve a specific chat session and all its messages in chronological order.

200.description: Chat session and conversation message history

get.description: Search and filter chat messages across sessions by role, text query, or session ID.

get.summary: Get Granular Chat Turn Trace Bundle
get.description: Retrieve the forensic telemetry and execution bundle for a single conversational turn (by traceId or messageId), including token usage, exact reasoning and TTS costs, relational memory, protocols, Field coverage, tool calls, and voice lifecycle.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Telemetry trace ID (e.g. 'trace_...') or Assistant Message ID (e.g. 'chat_...')

200.description: Comprehensive turn trace and execution bundle

get.description: List conversational quality audits and rubric scores (grounding, restraint, earned significance, lunar relevance, tool discipline).

post.description: Log a structured rubric evaluation for a conversational turn trace.

get.description: Aggregate tokens, voice seconds, and costs across sessions and dates.

name.description: Human readable phase name (e.g. Full Moon)

lunarMonth.description: Traditional name of lunar cycle (e.g. Sturgeon)

text.description: Insight or reflection content derived from dialogue

BearerAuth.description: Provide your Supabase access token or API Key in the Authorization header: 'Bearer <token>'
